newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Credit files $1 bln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Credit files $1 bln debt shelf.

text.p: Commercial Credit Co, a unit of Travelers Group Inc, filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $1 billion in debt securities.
Together with previously registered securities, the financial services holding company's shelf registration totals $1.55 billion.
The company plans to use proceeds from the sale for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying oustanding debt.
The company said a portion may also be used to finance in part its proposed $1.6 billion acquisition of Security Pacific Financial Services Inc from BankAmerica Corp.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
